sections.content: Use cuando when you want to identify the moment one completed event happened. Use mientras when you want to show that two actions happened at the same time. Compare: Cuando llegamos, recibimos los guantes. Mientras trabajamos, hablamos con otras personas.

items.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves.

items.spanish: Mientras trabajamos, hablamos con otras people.
items.english: While we worked, we spoke with other people.

items.spanish: Cuando terminó el día, volvimos a casa.
items.english: When the day ended, we went home.

items.spanish: Mientras limpiamos, otros voluntarios plantaron flores.
items.english: While we cleaned, other volunteers planted flowers.

sections.content: Use cuando to say when a completed event happened. Use mientras when two actions happened at the same time.
